snippet.title: Wanech's Z.O.O. Trailer
snippet.description:
After wrapping up the hit Amborettio, Wanech established a command post for Wanech’s Z.O.O. (Zoological Outreach Operation). The HQ hums with chiptune pings—retro, cozy, and just a little heroic.

In this top-down clicker-typer with arcade bursts, you’ll rescue animals and grow habitats. Type the 3-letter prompts to complete rescues, click falling pickups for bonus Fish/Leaves, and trade resources into SCORE. Invest in upgrades to automate income and obtain Marine Prestige and Forest Prestige to further unlock achievements—then watch your sanctuary come alive.

Nobody’s sure why Wanech swapped dungeons for dens—some say it’s all to protect the creatures of Amborettio. Whatever the reason, your mission is clear: expand the Z.O.O., stack upgrades, and chase a flood of achievements, with chiptunes chirping and the rescues never stopping.

Music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio
